name: Marlon T. Argente
tagline: Enterprise IT infrastructure, networking, automation, and AI-assisted software engineering.

hero.headline: 15+ years keeping enterprises running — now building the next generation with AI-assisted engineering.
hero.subheadline: I design and maintain enterprise IT infrastructure, networks, and automation systems, and I document how I work. This portfolio is a living engineering workspace: real projects, real decisions, real verification — built with the help of a local AI engineering environment where every change is planned, tested, verified, and reviewed.

bio: Highly accomplished IT Specialist and Software Support Engineer with over 15 years of experience managing enterprise IT infrastructure, digital laboratories, and asset systems across government and academic institutions. Proven expertise in full-stack hardware diagnostics, Windows Server administration, network deployment, and rigorous asset auditing compliant with ISO quality standards. Adept at managing large-scale data integrity operations, resolving complex software architecture bottlenecks, and enforcing organizational cybersecurity practices. Currently exploring AI-assisted software development and agentic engineering workflows.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
education.institution: AMA Computer College, Lucena City, Philippines

currentlyBuilding.description: Building a local-first AI engineering command center with project scanning, planning, task management, verification and knowledge management. The portfolio you are reading is the controlled public window into that workspace.

methodology.detail: Define the problem and constraints before touching anything.
Scan evidence, read existing code and infrastructure, check current documentation.
Break work into atomic tasks with dependencies; plans are reviewed before implementation.
Implement task by task, matching the project's existing conventions.
Automated tests plus manual verification of the actual behavior.
Record evidence and confidence levels. Never claim completion without evidence.
Write decisions, findings and resume notes so work can continue.
Review what worked and what didn't; fold lessons into the next iteration.

aiUsage.headline: AI as an engineering assistant — not an uncontrolled replacement for verification.
usedFor: Planning and breaking work into atomic tasks
Security review of code and configuration
aiUsage.principle: AI-generated output is reviewed, tested, and verified before being accepted. Nothing is published automatically.

contact.note: Prefer email for project inquiries. I respond to technical questions about infrastructure, automation, and how work was planned, verified, and tested.
